# SYNESIS_E113 — Error

## Description

`concept_a`: more than one preferred label.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The concept `concept_a` has 2 preferred labels (example_a, example_b).
  LABEL PREFERRED takes a single term; the others go in LABEL ALTERNATIVE.
```
